text: The Daslaor Applied Research Lab is headed by Votirmi Tresbior and has 20 people, including Givien Mubren, Gonnom Gosmunza, Hethe Potannuel, Gehoel Karherel, Zerfuan Thasdaett, Nufeis Rangoen, Hoha Stebremen, Krodaor Thaborine, and Zodoine Vemdaen. The lab owns Project Statugoan, Project Tholgu, and Project Vumzosa.
